standard.coverage: All employers except the state, its political subdivisions, and small businesses grossing under $500,000 that are exempt from the FLSA.
standard.note: Annual CPI adjustment under the Fair Wages and Healthy Families Act (Prop 206, 2016). 2027: $15.65 (see provisional.updatedFor2027).

tipped.note: A.R.S. 23-363(C) caps the tip credit at $3.00/hr flat -- a fixed DOLLAR credit, not a percentage, so it does not grow with the minimum wage.

indexation.basis: CPI-U (US city average), rounded to the nearest $0.05

knownGaps: Flagstaff and Tucson set higher local minimum wages -- see local/AZ-local-2026.json.

sources.title: Industrial Commission of Arizona 2027 minimum wage (press reports)
sources.verifiedBy: NOT read from azica.gov (its page still lists the 2026 poster). Arizona Capitol Times (2026-09-14), Herald/Review (2026-09-30, 'the Industrial Commission of Arizona announced') and WGA all report $15.65, which is $15.15 raised by CPI and rounded to the nearest nickel as the statute requires. Tipped $12.65 = $15.65 less the $3.00 tip credit.

sources.title: U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division -- State Minimum Wage Laws (table current as of July 1, 2026)
sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session. DOL's own state-by-state table is the spine of every standard rate in this database; where a state's own labor department was ALSO read directly, that source is listed too and wins on any disagreement (see South Dakota's tipped cash wage for the one case where they disagreed).

sources.verifiedBy: Fetched and read directly this session. Source of the combined rate / maximum tip credit / minimum cash wage triple and the 'tipped employee' monthly-tips definition for every state and territory in this database.
